summary: Mearns Castle is a 15th-century tower house in Newton Mearns, East Renfrewshire, south of Glasgow, Scotland. It is a Category A listed building that has been restored and now forms part of the Maxwell Mearns Castle Church. The castle also lends its name to the nearby Mearns Castle High School.
